integrity: Analytical theorem and reproducible finite checks; no independent validation or claim of general nonlinear applicability.
scientific_limitations: Requires centered nondegenerate stationary joint Gaussian (position,velocity) with dX=Vdt; linearized inertial regimes only, not full orientation-dependent nonlinear dynamics. Instantaneous angular momentum, not integrated current.
title: Exact fluctuation-symmetry obstruction for stationary Gaussian inertial gyrators
